body:
# Create+ 1870

Create+ 1870 is a curated Create modpack for NeoForge 1.21.1. The technology level is modeled after the 1870 to 1910 era - steam, steel, rails, airships and early electrical industrialization. No futuristic tech, no magic, and no modern weapons. The pack includes a big Create suite with over 20 add-ons, plus world generation enhancements, quality-of-life mods, and performance optimizations. 

### Updates
This modpack is still undergoung big updates. Some mods may require creation of a new save/world if mods get removed! Before updating, please read the changelog carefully and remove any blocks associated with the removed mod.

## ⚙️ Create & Automation

The heart of the pack - everything Create has to offer and more:

- **[Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)** - rotations, belts, trains, and mechanical power
- **[Power Grid](https://modrinth.com/mod/power-grid)** - create custom circuits and start the second industrial revolution!
- **[Create: Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics)** - build and pilot airships
- **[Create Aeronautics: Encased Fluid Pipes](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics-encased-fluid-pipes)** - transport fluids through your vessels
- **[Carry On: Aeronautics Compat](https://modrinth.com/mod/carryon-aeronautics-compat)** - carry airship components
- **[Create: Big Cannons](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-big-cannons)** - custom artillery and siege warfare
- **[Create: Steam 'n' Rails](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-steam-n-rails-1.21.1)** - expanded trains and tracks
- **[Create Enchantment Industry](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-enchantment-industry)** - automate enchanting with Create machines
- **[Create Factory](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-factory)** - industrial-scale production lines
- **[Create Framed](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-framed)** - decorative mechanical blocks
- **[Create Alloyed](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-alloyed)** - bronze and steel alloys
- **[Slice and Dice](https://modrinth.com/mod/slice-and-dice)** - automated cooking and food processing

## 🔧 Addons & Tweaks
- **[Create: Crafts & Additions](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-ca)** - electric motors and connectors
- **[Extended Wrenches](https://modrinth.com/mod/extended-wrenches)** - more wrench variants
- **[Create: Smart Bounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-smart-bounds)** - intelligent contraption boundaries
- **[Create Ballast](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-ballast)** - stability blocks for airships
- **[Create Bits n' Bobs](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-bits-n-bobs)** - miscellaneous Create gadgets
- **[Create Cardboarded Conveynience](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-cardboarded-conveynience)** - cardboard box logistics
- **[Create: Dragons Plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-dragons-plus)** - dragon-themed addons
- **[Create: Pattern Schematics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-pattern-schematics)** - share and reuse build patterns
- **[Create: Shuffle Filter](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-shuffle-filter)** - advanced item filtering
- **[Create: Prismatic Shine](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-prismatic-shine)** - visual polish
- **[Bells & Whistles](https://modrinth.com/mod/bellsandwhistles)** - Create-aligned decoration
- **[Konkrete](https://modrinth.com/mod/konkrete)** - concrete and construction expansion
- **[Create Dragons Plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-dragons-plus)** - draconic Create content

## 🗺️ World & Exploration

The world is bigger, deeper, and more rewarding:

- **YUNG's Better Series** - improved Dungeons, Strongholds, Ocean Monuments, Desert Temples, Nether Fortresses
- **[Ecologics](https://modrinth.com/mod/ecologics)** - new biomes and wildlife
- **[Supplementaries](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries)** - décor, redstone gadgets, and world flair
- **[Amendments](https://modrinth.com/mod/amendments)** - visual and functional block tweaks
- **[Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped)** - hundreds of new block variants
- **[Another Furniture](https://modrinth.com/mod/another-furniture)** - chairs, tables, cabinets
- **[Brick & Mortar](https://modrinth.com/mod/brick-and-mortar)** - decorative building blocks
- **[Quark](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark) + [Zeta](https://modrinth.com/mod/zeta)** - vanilla-friendly tweaks and additions
- **[Fast Paintings](https://modrinth.com/mod/fast-paintings)** - optimized paintings

## 🎯 Quality of Life

- **[EMI](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi) + [EMI Loot](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi-loot)** - recipe viewer and loot table browser
- **[The One Probe](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-one-probe)** - see block details at a glance
- **[Carry On](https://modrinth.com/mod/carry-on)** - pick up and move chests, spawners, and more
- **[Lootr](https://modrinth.com/mod/lootr)** - instanced loot per player
- **[GraveStone](https://modrinth.com/mod/gravestone-mod)** - death chests
- **[Timber Strike](https://modrinth.com/mod/timber-strike)** - fell entire trees with one cut
- **[Quick Pack](https://modrinth.com/mod/quick-pack)** - rapid item sorting
- **[Simple Storage Network](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-storage-network)** - wireless item access
- **[Map Atlases](https://modrinth.com/mod/map-atlases-forge)** - craftable, zoomable maps
- **[Easy Anvils](https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-anvils)** - easier anvil renaming
- **[Reliable Advancements](https://modrinth.com/mod/reliable-advancements)** - advancement re-locking for multiplayer
- **[Armor Statues](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-statues)** - fully poseable armor stands

## 🍳 Farming & Cooking

- **[Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight)** - the ultimate farming and cooking overhaul
- **[My Nether's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/my-nethers-delight)** - Nether crops and dishes
- **[End's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/ends-delight)** - End-themed food
- **[Miner's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/miners-delight)** - underground foraging and cooking

- **[Smarter Farmers](https://modrinth.com/mod/smarter-farmers-farmers-replant)** - villagers that actually farm

## 📦 Storage

- **[Sophisticated Backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks)** - upgradable backpacks
- **[Sophisticated Storage](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-storage) + [Create Integration](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-storage-create-integration)** - chests, barrels and Create automation
- **[Simple Storage Network](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-storage-network)**
- **[Potion Stacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/potion-stacks)** - stackable potions
- **[TrashSlot](https://modrinth.com/mod/trashslot)** - quick item deletion

## ⚡ Performance

- **[ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix)** - runtime optimizations and bug fixes
- **[Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)** - general server-side performance
- **[FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core)** - memory footprint reduction
- **[C2ME](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-neoforge)** - concurrent chunk generation and loading
- **[Structure Layout Optimizer](https://modrinth.com/mod/structure-layout-optimizer)** - faster structure placement
- **[Async Logger](https://modrinth.com/mod/asynclogger)** - non-blocking logging
- **[Flerovium](https://modrinth.com/mod/flerovium)** - data-driven performance improvements
- **[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)**
- **[Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra)**

## Decorative

- **[Macaw's Bridges](https://modrinth.com/mod/macaws-bridges)**
- **[Macaw's Doors](https://modrinth.com/mod/macaws-doors)**
- **[Macaw's Fences and Walls](https://modrinth.com/mod/macaws-fences-and-walls)**

- **[Macaw's Trapdoors](https://modrinth.com/mod/macaws-trapdoors)**
- **[Macaw's Windows](https://modrinth.com/mod/macaws-windows)**
